$comment: Shrink-only floors for JOV-6773 (DS drift: destructive/red -> error token, apps/web). destructiveUtilityCount: {text,bg,border,ring}-destructive is a value-preserving alias of -error (tailwind.config.js maps both to --color-error) -- lower this whenever a follow-up codemods more apps/web call sites. One occurrence (app/globals.css .text-destructive) is expected to remain indefinitely: packages/ui keeps the shadcn destructive variant/prop, and this rule backstops its color resolution. 172->127 in JOV-6773 after converging the apps/web call sites clear of both the component-ship-gate and pre-existing shadcn/no-restyle debt: non-component app/lib files, plus the two apps/web/components pairs whose adjacent test already asserted on the class (SettingsPaymentsSection, BillingActionsSection). One otherwise-safe file (app/app/(shell)/admin/agent-runs/[id]/page.tsx) was left unconverted because it carries an unrelated pre-existing shadcn/no-restyle violation (Card padding) that lint-staged's whole-file --max-warnings=0 run would force this PR to fix; that file's rename is deferred to whoever clears its restyle debt. The remaining components-dir occurrences are blocked from this pass because touching apps/web/components/**/*.tsx under the ship gate requires a touched test that actually renders the component (or a coverage-via receipt) plus an adjacent story in the same diff -- ~26 of those files have no story yet and ~14 have no test that renders them, so converting them means adding that missing coverage first, tracked as a follow-up. 127->123 and 123->121 in later JOV-6773 destructive-utility follow-ups converging more apps/web call sites onto -error. 121->116 in JOV-6778 orphan sweep (deleted smart-handle-input orphan). rawRedUtilityCount: {text,bg,border,ring}-red-NNN is NOT the same value as --color-error (Tailwind red-500 #ef4444 vs --color-accent-red #f72a36), and not every red-* call site is a danger/error state (e.g. the YouTube brand swatch) -- this floor only blocks new raw-red debt from growing until each call site gets a taste/design review to either become -error or a named brand token. 86->48 in a JOV-6773 desaturation follow-up: 18 danger/error components (admin issue/priority pills, waitlist/onboarding/profile-notification form errors, public-profile error state, release-overdue badge, swipe-to-delete affordance, dev-toolbar production warning) converged onto -error, plus one brand swatch (/exp/right-rail-shotgun YouTube) onto its existing bg-brand-youtube token. 48->27 in a second JOV-6773 desaturation follow-up: 12 more danger/error components (dev toolbar, match-confidence breakdown, segmented digit box error state, onboarding tool-artifact tone/availability icons, chat-style and sortable link-item swipe-to-delete, listen-now-form remove-link affordance, release-task overdue count, onboarding-shell claim-error status, waitlist-intake validation error, ad-pixels health indicator and test-event alert, profile-review name-validation error) converged onto -error, each gaining a colocated or extended test asserting the token. 27->22 in a third JOV-6773 desaturation follow-up: PerformanceDashboard (poor-rating badge), SettingsSmsAccessSection (request-failed error), AddPlatformDialog (inline validation alert), and ChatAlbumArtCard (apply-artwork failure) each converged onto -error with a new or extended test and a new story (none had one). While landing this batch also fixed two component-ship-policy false positives that were blocking otherwise-safe conversions: extractRequiredPropNames/story-state-matrix were scanning the whole file for any *Props interface or a bare `disabled` substring instead of the exported component's own props, so an unrelated internal sub-component interface (or a Tailwind `disabled:opacity-50` variant in a className string) could masquerade as a required/state-matrix prop -- see findComponentPropsBlocks in component-ship-policy.mjs. 27->25 in JOV-6778 orphan sweep (deleted smart-handle-input orphan, which also carried 2 raw red-* occurrences). 20->15 in JOV-6778 orphan sweep batch 2: PerformanceDashboard.tsx (poor-rating badge, the file's raw-red occurrence) was a confirmed zero-importer orphan, deleted with its test and story rather than converted; that same batch also deleted ProblemStatement.tsx and SectionVariantPreview.tsx as zero-importer orphans. In a parallel JOV-6773 PR4, rebased onto that same batch: exempted components/design-studio/** from component-ship-gate's story requirement (test still required) since storybook-story-quality-guard's no-design-studio-product-stories rule unconditionally bans a story there -- the two gates no longer contradict each other for any future design-studio file, though SectionVariantPreview.tsx itself (the file that surfaced the contradiction) was deleted as an orphan by the batch above before this PR could convert it, same fate as DspMatchList.tsx before it (#19445). That PR also fixed artist-notifications-cta/shared.tsx's pre-existing shadcn/no-restyle debt at the root instead of leaving it skipped: TooltipContent gained a `tone` prop ('default' | 'danger') so a danger tooltip uses TOOLTIP_SURFACE_DANGER (border-error/30 bg-error-subtle text-error, the same tokens as MENU_ITEM_DESTRUCTIVE and Banner's error variant) instead of a raw-red className restyle, and the loading skeleton switched from <Skeleton rounded> (whose preset scale doesn't cover the file's bespoke rounded-[2rem]) to <LoadingSkeleton height width rounded='full'>, which takes geometry as props instead of a className the lint can't approve -- h-14 clamps to the same radius as rounded-full, so this is a visual no-op. That converted shared.tsx's 4 live occurrences (the tooltip's 3 plus the desktop error affordance) onto -error, and surfaced a previously-uncounted dead-code occurrence there (subscriptionErrorTextClassName, unused export) flagged to orphan-6778's next batch rather than color-fixed. Count re-derived live against the merged tree (both changes landed): see rawRedUtilityCount below. Remaining after both: lib/discography/release-type-styles.ts (7) and the release 'E' explicit-content badge in ReleaseMetadata.tsx (3) are decorative, low-opacity (8-15%) categorical tags judged not distracting per Tim's per-site call; artist-notifications-cta/shared.tsx's subscriptionErrorTextClassName (1) is dead code -- exported but never imported anywhere -- flagged to orphan-6778's next batch instead of color-fixed. 11->10 in the final JOV-6773 cleanup: deleted subscriptionErrorTextClassName itself (confirmed zero importers repo-wide) rather than waiting on orphan-6778's next batch. Remaining after this PR (10) is entirely decorative and intentionally untouched: lib/discography/release-type-styles.ts (7) and the release 'E' explicit-content badge in ReleaseMetadata.tsx (3), low-opacity (8-15%) categorical tags judged not distracting per Tim's per-site call. JOV-6773 is closed at this floor. 116->114 under JOV-6015: converted the last two non-component-ship-gate call sites left by JOV-6773 -- app/app/(shell)/admin/agent-runs/[id]/page.tsx (also dropped the dead p-0 restyle on unstyled ContentSurfaceCard that had blocked its earlier conversion and cleared the file's shadcn/no-restyle error) and components/features/home/claim-handle/useHelperState.ts (a .ts hook outside .tsx ship scope). The remainder is all components/**/*.tsx debt still gated on per-file test+story coverage. deadDangerUtilityCount is a NEW zero-floor metric (not shrink-only debt): {text,bg,border,ring}-danger and -danger-token have NO theme color or component rule -- every use renders an unstyled inherited-color error state, i.e. an invisible error message, which is a bug rather than drift. JOV-6015 fixed the two live bugs (ChatLinkConfirmationCard text-danger-token, ProfileAboutTab press-photo text-danger) onto text-error and locked the floor at 0; any new -danger/-danger-token use is a regression. 114->112 under JOV-7650: main pushes landed two more -destructive -> -error conversions, dropping the live count below the floor and failing the shrink-only ratchet; the baseline is lowered to lock in the progress.
